name: @earendil-works/elanor-logos
description: Earendil, Pi, Radius, and Lefos logos as SVG files.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/build.ts && tsx scripts/export.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm run check:prepare && tsx scripts/check.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run check:prepare && pnpm run build && vitest run --dir tests
